brief.text: Energy driller BORR generated the board's largest cluster filing at $81.9 million across two buyers, outpacing major commitments in COHR at $51.1 million and BPRE at $41.7 million. Closed-end funds and savings institutions both appear multiple times in the cluster log, though BBT stands out for drawing the highest overall participant count with four insiders. Meanwhile, Saba Capital Management dominated individual filings by buying across four separate fund tickers, highlighted by a $5.1 million purchase in DXYZ.
